Withdrawal requests submitted before 17:00 UTC are usually reviewed on the same business day. Bank withdrawals may take 1 to 3 business days after approval. E-wallet withdrawals are typically
processed within 4 hours after approval. If an account is under compliance review, withdrawals remain pending until the review is completed. Users can check the withdrawal status from the cashier
Proof of identity documents must be valid and unexpired. Proof of address documents must show the user's full name, address, and issue date. Utility bills older than 6 months are not accepted. Bank
statements older than 3 months are not accepted. Images must be clear, uncropped, and readable.
